costumes.name: Wave of Disbelief
costumes.description:
Guilty costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: This thing is so stifling... Any chance I can have this untied?
Didn't you say you trusted me? So why won't you untie me?
How long do I have to stay like this, Counselor?
Haven't I been doing well in my rehabilitation, Counselor? Why don't you untie me just this once?
Do you like what you see, Counselor?
Just because I'm in these restraints, you think you can touch me however you want??
Ugh, so bored... I should just end my life and be done with it.
Why don't you come closer? I want to hold your hand, Counselor...
It really is nice here... It's not nearly as stuffy as the Rehabilitation Center...
This is the Courthouse, isn't it? You're not trying to have me punished again, right?
When I was at the Courthouse, I encountered some patients I've seen at the Rehabilitation Center. Are you sure it's a good idea to gather so many of us under one roof?

Since you rehabilitated me,
I don't want you straying too far. All right?
Wow, I've gotten stronger!
This'll make me a force to be reckoned with. Are you sure this is all right?
Just once... I'd love to use my powers to my heart's content.
A gift? Why are you giving me this? You want me to like you?
So this is the kind of stuff you get when you're rehabilitated? That's simply amazing!
I don't need any of these things. To be able to hold your hand is the greatest gift of all, but still, thanks...
The odd thing is I want you more and more, Counselor...
Don't be afraid of me, Counselor... Please learn to trust me...

Being rehabilitated sure has its perks,
like say... being with you, Counselor.
Counselor, you need me...?
Hm... What should I do now?
Do I really need to go all the way over there?
Time to cut loose.
It's nice being able to move my arms.
My hands are free... I wanna break something!
You released me, I'll do as you say, Counselor.
Gotta be prepared...
Guns are boring... I like using my fists...
You gotta be careful, else the gun will break...
Counselor...
No restraints, no mercy!
Don't run away! Let's play together!
One down.
Who's next?
So happy!
Ugh...
That hurts...
Ow!
So tired... I'm tapping out.
This is what you wanted, right? Did I do well?
This outfit isn't too... restrictive. It's quite nice, actually.
Would you... like to have some ice cream with me, Counselor?
You weren't lying about us spending next summer together, were you?
Counselor, I'm feeling a bit... uncomfortable. Could you... maybe loosen this for me? If you want, you could even untie it completely...

This summer was nice... I even made some new friends...
Though, I'm not sure how long they'll be able to put up with me.

I never thought I'd have the opportunity to enjoy the summer with you, Counselor.
I'm glad I was able to leave the Rehabilitation Center.
I'm so bored... Maybe I could browse through the photos I took last time...

How can you ignore me when you're the one who made me wear this?
Don't be like that. Come here and hold my hand.

Maiden was teaching me how to play a game,
but I got a bit angry and hit the keyboard, and now it's busted.
You said that's the swimming pool, right? Do you think there's a Great White Shark in there?

Do you think we could smash some watermelons here?
I'm really good at it.
This is just something I got for summer, but... what do you think, Counselor?
Can you handle my strength...?
Thinking about the sea while wearing a swimsuit makes me feel stronger.
I'll never lose you now.
The world outside the Rehabilitation Center is such a joyous place.

Can... can I touch this?
It won't break, right?
I still want more...
Thank you for believing in me with all your heart.
I'll stay still... You're free to handle this however you wish, Counselor.
Thanks for helping me with my swimsuit. You're more than welcome to do the same for me again in the future.
It's time to use physical force now.
What's the matter...?
Counselor, can I hold your hand while we move out?
Counselor, you have to let go of my hand now.
Is it okay if I hug you tight?
I'll destroy it all...
It's hot out here, so I'll finish this quick.
It's such a hassle to reload.
I want to use my bare hands.
Wait a moment...
I think it's my turn, Counselor.
Do you really think... you can handle me?
I don't need to hold back anymore.
It shattered...
How boring.
So this is how it feels...
Ugh!
That hurt!
I'm tired... I think I'll stop now.
Is this proof enough of my feelings for you?
